answer: Bind each identity to exactly one carrier-verified mobile subscription. The carrier confirms, under its own KYC, an active postpaid contract and billing history; anonymous prepaid SIMs are rejected, one number backs one identity, and a lapsed subscription suspends the identity. Reaching that summit needs more than a vault of bought numbers: each identity must stand on its own shale footing. A sybil farm therefore needs a separate KYC contract and monthly bill per fake, while bulk SIM purchases trigger the carrier's fraud team, which can revoke the whole cluster at once.
